jobs.title: Software Solutions Project Manager (BF3544B)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with an established UK software and services business that provides cloud-based infrastructure-management systems to local authorities and utility-sector organisations. Its project team delivers implementations, development work and change programmes that connect customer requirements with product, consultancy and technical delivery.

This role takes responsibility for software projects across the full lifecycle, from scope and planning through governance, delivery and closure. You will be the main customer contact, coordinating colleagues and third parties who may not report directly to you, while keeping scope, quality, budget and timescales under control. The opportunity is available on either a permanent basis or as a 12-month fixed-term appointment.

The Role

Manage the end-to-end delivery of software implementations, development, consultancy and change projects.
Define scope, objectives, deliverables and acceptance criteria, then maintain project plans, schedules, budgets and resource forecasts.
Track progress and manage risks, issues, dependencies and change requests, escalating clearly when delivery is at risk.
Act as the primary customer contact, chairing project meetings, workshops, reviews and steering groups.
Coordinate resources across professional services, product, support, development and account management, building accountability through influence rather than line authority.
Monitor project commercials, including budgets, profitability and utilisation, while maintaining contractual and governance standards.
Keep status reports, RAID logs and other project records accurate, and use lessons learned to improve future delivery.

What We're Looking For

Proven experience delivering software development, implementation or digital-transformation projects.
The ability to run several projects and competing priorities without losing control of detail, outcomes or stakeholder communication.
Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, including the credibility to lead cross-functional groups and handle difficult conversations calmly.
Commercial awareness and practical experience managing budgets, resources, risks and governance documentation.
Clear written and verbal communication, with an ability to translate technical subjects into business-focused decisions.
A collaborative, resilient approach and the judgement to balance customer expectations with operational constraints.

Experience with SaaS, cloud or enterprise software, release management, and Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methods would be valuable. PRINCE2 Practitioner, AgilePM, PMP, APM PMQ or an equivalent qualification is desirable rather than essential.

This could suit a Software Project Manager, Implementation Project Manager or Digital Project Manager who enjoys client-facing delivery and can align specialists around a shared plan without relying on formal authority.

jobs.location: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about developing digital solutions that enable the delivery of clinical supplies to patients around the world? Do you thrive in a role where software development, manufacturing systems and business processes come together? If so, you could be our new Senior IT Process Engineer in Clinical Supplies Digital Solution.

Your new role

As Senior IT Process Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, optimisation, and support of POMS
, a business-critical Manufacturing Execution System (MES) supporting Clinical Supplies packaging and shipping processes.

Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, and external partners, you will drive the continuous improvement of POMS and related business processes, ensuring the solution remains reliable, compliant, and fit for future growth. Over time, you may also contribute to the wider digital landscape, including technologies such as Databricks, helping to strengthen the digital capabilities that support the global Clinical Supplies supply chain.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Designing, building, testing, and supporting .NET/C# applications, APIs, interfaces, background services, and custom MES functionality.
Developing and maintaining SQL databases, data models, stored procedures, and integrations that support business-critical processes.
Driving optimisation and continuous improvement of POMS and related Clinical Supplies processes.
Translating business requirements into robust, scalable, and compliant technical solutions.
Collaborating with stakeholders across Clinical Supplies, Quality, Validation, and IT to ensure alignment between business needs and system capabilities.
Coordinating development activities delivered by external suppliers and ensuring successful implementation of new functionality.
Supporting testing, validation, releases, change management, and system improvements in accordance with GMP/GxP requirements.
Acting as a technical problem solver and driving resolution of complex incidents and operational challenges.

You will have significant ownership of your area and the opportunity to influence the future digital landscape supporting Clinical Supplies.

Your new department

You will join CS Digital Solution
, a team responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting digital solutions used throughout Clinical Supplies.

We work closely with colleagues across Line of Business, Quality, Validation, and IT to deliver reliable, compliant, and innovative solutions that support the supply of clinical products globally. The team combines strong technical expertise with deep business understanding and has a clear focus on continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value to patients through digital innovation.

You will become part of an ambitious and supportive environment where knowledge sharing, professional development, and teamwork are key elements of how we work together.

Your Skills And Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional .NET/C# development experience.
5-10 years of hands-on SQL development experience, including database design, complex queries, and performance optimisation.
Experience working in GMP- or GxP-regulated environments.
Strong understanding of computer system validation, data integrity, and quality processes.
Experience developing enterprise-level applications, interfaces, integrations, APIs, schedulers, or similar technical solutions.
Hands-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) is required. Experience with POMS, PAS-X, or comparable MES platforms is considered essential for success in this role.

In Addition, We Are Looking For Someone Who

Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Can work independently while navigating a complex stakeholder landscape.
Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Enjoys collaborating across functions and building strong working relationships.
Is fluent in English, written and spoken.

Experience from the pharmaceutical industry and familiarity with Clinical Supplies processes would be considered an advantage.

Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Every day, our employees work to improve the lives of millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.

We believe that success comes from diverse perspectives, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge the status quo. That's why we create an environment where talented people can grow, collaborate, and make a meaningful difference.

When you join Novo Nordisk, you become part of a company with a strong purpose, ambitious goals, and opportunities for both professional and personal development.

What We Offer

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline

27 September 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

About Slalom

Slalom is a global, human-centric business and technology consulting firm. We specialise in partnering with organisations that aspire to excellence, helping them tackle complex challenges and achieve transformative results through strategy, technology, and business transformation services. By prioritising people, Slalom creates a unique consulting experience, with a team of strategists and engineers delivering practical, end-to-end solutions that drive impactful outcomes for our clients. We empower people and organisations to dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all.

Who You’ll Work With

Slalom Build capability is Slalom’s technology powerhouse, dedicated to engineering, cutting-edge technologies, and modern development practices. We embrace diversity of thought and background, fostering a culture that values creativity and collaboration. As a trusted partner, Slalom Build helps clients maximize the value of their software by delivering fast, high-quality, and consistent solutions. We combine strategic thinking with AI-driven tools to support end-to-end delivery at any scale. Our focus is not only on building great solutions, but also on empowering people and creating lasting impact.

What You’ll Do

Advise clients on the overall enterprise architecture landscape on various solution architecture areas including technology, information, data, security, and integration.
Implement and architect large scale, innovative IT solutions to drive business transformation.
Evaluate and identify IT-related risks, including compliance, operations, revenue, and growth risks.
Engage as a trusted advisor across technology topics and the software lifecycle, articulating ROI, risk, and value.
Develop, as part of a team, technology strategy and planning deliverables to address IT risks and improve effectiveness of the IT organization, specifically focusing on business application integration.
Produce target state solution architectures, perform architectural assessment and gap analysis and help formulate the overall solution strategy and roadmap.
Write technical designs and documentation; provide guidance and training to clients.
Collaborate with clients and Slalom consultants to translate business requirements into technical requirements.
Define activities, work products, staffing plans, cost estimations, and schedules required for migration/modernization consultation in proposals and SOWs.
Contributes to delivery via billable roles as Delivery Solution Lead and/or in SME roles within market’s portfolio, with specific utilization target defined by level.

What You’ll Bring

Strong ability to share ideas and communicate with peers and clients.
Ability to lead solutioning during proposal phases or offering development.
Fluency in the development and use of solution architecture frameworks, patterns, and best practices to drive business transformation. Familiarity and exposure to Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies.
Experience in analyzing business and technology requirements to design and build scalable enterprise application architectures. Ability to explain principles of application architecture to clients using value-based frameworks.
Experience with client or stakeholder negotiations and presentations.
Bring strong experience in software engineering and DevOps, particularly in production environments using AWS.
Design and implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application delivery.
Apply expertise in configuration management and infrastructure as code, using tools such as:
- Chef, Puppet, Ansible
- Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM
Contribute to security-focused engineering practices, including:
- Identity and access management
- Firewall configuration
- Fundamental cloud security principles
Knowledge of application development practices including Agile and SAFe, systems development lifecycle, GitOps, and implementation of software products.
Demonstrate a growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies quickly
Use acquired knowledge to solve practical business problems for customers
Demonstrable experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Passion for learning and a proactive approach; able to identify gaps, suggest improvements, and self-manage responsibilities.
Willingness to be a part of high-performing team in a diverse environment, and ability to thrive in ambiguity. 
4+ years of experience in application architecture, development, or modernization.

Nice to Have:

Proficiency in at least one programming language.
Expertise in two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Hands-on experience with migration tooling (e.g., AWS MGN, Cloudamize).
Hands-on experience delivering migration or modernization projects.
Application rationalization or 7R evaluation experience.
Experience with legacy-to-modern transformations (Java/.NET to containerized or serverless architectures).
AWS certifications such as:
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate/Professional
- AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, or AWS Certified Developer - Associate.

About Us

Deep connections, better outcome

We have deep relationships with leading technology partners and they love us for our innovative and outcome based approach. Our people are passionate about solving our clients problems using the tech that’s the best solution for them. What’s more, we’re there to work side-by-side with our client teams to enable them for success long after we’ve gone. We’re all about momentum that outlasts us.
Flexibility

Life is busy, and we understand that. Our team often juggles work, family, personal commitments, and crucial client obligations. We prioritise supporting our people in balancing what matters to them while ensuring we meet our client commitments. Flexibility is key, as we sometimes need to adapt to meet client needs. This way, our team can work on high-impact projects they’ll love, knowing they have the flexibility to manage their personal and professional lives effectively.
People-first

Great solutions start with great people. At our employee-led company, your voice matters, and we love to hear your feedback. By leading with kindness, empathy, and striving for equity, we create better experiences for everyone. Our culture encourages passion, adventure, adaptability, and diverse thinking. Inclusion, diversity, and equity are our top priorities, empowering our team to be their best selves. Together, we can create a great future by working collaboratively and supporting each other.

What keeps us here?  

Our Singapore office knows the importance of a good work/life balance. We have the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way. We make a big effort to bring everyone together and allow space when space is needed. We believe in helping each other thrive in work and life and are proud to invest in benefits that include holistic well-being, meaningful allowances, and investment in our team’s professional, technical, and personal growth.

It’s an exciting time to be one of our foundational members, getting involved in setting up our unique Singapore culture.

Daarnaast documenteer je bouwtesten en los je incidenten en technische knelpunten efficiënt op.

je een sleutelrol hebt in de ontwikkeling en modernisering van een van de grootste .NET-toepassingen van Nederland en helpt een complex systeem van ongeveer 30 componenten en 16.000 functiepunten 24/7 beschikbaar te houden voor miljoenen burgers en bedrijven;
je de mogelijkheid krijgt om technische keuzes en architectuur te beïnvloeden en best practices te implementeren binnen een complexe IT-omgeving;
je actief bijdraagt aan de coaching en ontwikkeling van junior en medior developers, waardoor je een belangrijke mentor rol vervult;
je de kans krijgt om je kennis en vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en een directe bijdrage te leveren aan de verbetering en innovatie van digitale overheidsdiensten.

"Wat mijn werk als senior .NET-developer zo interessant maakt, is de combinatie van technische diepgang en maatschappelijke impact. We werken aan complexe systemen voor miljoenen Nederlanders, terwijl er volop ruimte is om mee te denken over architectuur, innovatie en kennisdeling." Senior .NET-developer

Magellan Partners supports companies and organizations in their digital, organizational, and technological transformation projects. Our teams intervene on diverse issues: evolution of information systems, application modernization, organizational transformation, cloud, data, cybersecurity, employee experience, and operational performance improvement. Joining Magellan Partners means integrating a stimulating consulting environment based on expertise, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. You will evolve within communities of experts and work on high-stakes transformation projects with clients from various sectors. We pay special attention to supporting employees, developing skills, and building personalized career paths.

Your Mission

As a Web Development & DevOps Engineer, you will sit at the crossroads of development, infrastructure and cloud teams, architects, product teams, and clients. Your role consists of designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining robust, secure, and observable web applications, while industrializing delivery and operations processes, and leveraging artificial intelligence assistants to optimize productivity and code quality.

To this end, you will be responsible for:

Designing and Developing Web Applications (AI-Boosted)

Participate in the analysis of functional and technical requirements.
Design scalable, maintainable, and secure web solutions.
Develop front-end features using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
.
Develop back-end services and APIs using Node.js and/or Java / Spring Boot
.
Design and manage relational databases (e.g., SQL Server)
and non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB)
.
Integrate generative artificial intelligence into your daily development practices (code generation, refactoring, documentation, and task automation using tools such as Gemini CLI).

Participate in architectural choices and contribute to defining technical standards.
Fix bugs and ensure proactive and corrective maintenance of applications.
Write technical documentation and contribute to knowledge capitalization.

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD
.
Automate build, test, deployment, and delivery processes.
Containerize applications using Docker
.
Deploy and administer applications in Kubernetes
environments.
Automate infrastructure management with Terraform and Ansible
.
Work on GCP
environments and the company's internal cloud.
Contribute to managing development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement best practices for configuration management and version control using Git and GitLab
.

Enhancing Quality, Security, and Observability

Set up and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests.
Participate in code reviews and promote software development best practices.
Improve code quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Contribute to application monitoring, logging, and observability.
Participate in incident analysis and resolution.
Identify areas for improvement and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Integrate security requirements into development and deployment processes.

Collaboration and Team Support

Work within agile teams operating under Scrum or Kanban
methodologies.
Collaborate with product teams, developers, architects, and infrastructure/cloud teams.
Support product teams in adopting DevOps practices and raise awareness of AI best practices (effective prompting, AI code reviews).
Understand business challenges and challenge requirements when necessary.
Communicate clearly and pedagogically with both technical and business stakeholders.
Participate in knowledge sharing and animating expertise communities.
Represent Magellan Partners to clients with professionalism and a service-oriented mindset.

Achieve full autonomy across your application and DevOps scope.
Understand the technical, organizational, and business challenges of the project.
Master and integrate AI tools (notably Gemini CLI
) into your development routine to accelerate delivery.
Contribute to improving CI/CD pipelines and industrialization practices.
Participate in enhancing software quality and observability.

Share your experience and contribute to the dynamics of the technical community.

3 to 8 years of professional experience

Significant experience in designing and developing web applications.
